recipe.visualDefinition: A vintage 1960s album cover featuring a central framed photograph surrounded by ornate, swirling psychedelic filigree and bold, arched custom lettering at the top, with clean sans-serif tracklists flanking the image on a cream-white background.
coreVisualRelationships: Arched display type following the curve of the decorative filigree
High-contrast dark photograph framed by a thin double-line border
Symmetrical distribution of secondary text blocks
Vibrant primary colors against a neutral, aged paper background
coreInvariants: Arched title text with thick outlines

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A medium-shot photograph occupies the lower-center two-thirds of the layout, framed by a thin black border.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, arched, multi-colored title at the top serves as the primary entry point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the top title, follow the filigree curves down to the central photo, then move outward to the tracklists on the left and right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample cream-colored margins provide breathing room for the dense central graphics and text.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep Blue and Red (primary text fills)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Teal and Lime Green (filigree and outlines)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the graphic elements contrasts with the low-value, dark tones of the central photograph.

letterConstructionRules: Heavy weight with minimal internal counters
Thick, contrasting outlines (inline and outline effects)
Arched baseline for the top row; reverse-arched or straight for the second row
Tight letter spacing with slight overlaps
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters are distorted to fit the radial arc of the decorative header
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Maximalist custom display type paired with utilitarian, condensed mid-century sans-serif for legibility.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the bold, playful weight of the display type
Matches the utilitarian feel of the side tracklists

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a cream-colored vintage paper texture. In the center, place a square photograph of a man in a dark suit performing under stage lights, framed by a thin black double-line border. Above the photo, generate intricate teal and lime green psychedelic scrollwork and filigree that forms a wide arch.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add bold, arched uppercase lettering inside the filigree area at the top. Use a thick red fill with yellow and black outlines for the top row, and a blue fill with red and white outlines for the second row. Place two vertical lists of song titles in a bold, condensed black sans-serif font on the left and right sides of the central photo.

verificationChecks: Is the filigree teal and green?
Are the side lists in a condensed sans-serif?

adjustableVariables: Color of the display type fills
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the filigree does not overlap the central photo content.
Check that the arched text follows the curve of the scrollwork.
Verify the tracklist text is perfectly vertical and aligned.
Confirm the overall 'aged paper' look is consistent.
recipe.reuseFormula: Arched Psychedelic Header + Filigree Surround + Framed Central Photo + Flanking Condensed Lists
